id: \bLeon: I hope you're ready, \PN. Show me the power of Dynamax!
en: \bLeon: I hope you're ready, \PN. Show me the power of Dynamax!
it: \bDandel: Spero che tu sia pronto, \PN. Mostrami la potenza del Dynamax!

id: \bLeon: Excellent. Battles aren't fun unless they're serious. Let's have our next battle in front of a crowd during the height of the World Coronation Series.
en: \bLeon: Excellent. Battles aren't fun unless they're serious. Let's have our next battle in front of a crowd during the height of the World Coronation Series.
it: \bDandel: Eccellente. Le lotte non sono divertenti se non si fanno sul serio. Facciamo la nostra prossima lotta davanti al pubblico, nel pieno delle World Coronation Series.

id: \bThe new season is starting soon. I'm looking forward to seeing if you'll be a part of it.
en: \bThe new season is starting soon. I'm looking forward to seeing if you'll be a part of it.
it: \bLa nuova stagione inizierà presto. Non vedo l'ora di scoprire se ne farai parte.

id: \bGoh: Leon seems really strong.
en: \bGoh: Leon seems really strong.
it: \bGoh: Dandel sembra davvero forte.

id: \rCynthia: Good to see you, \PN. I've seen you grow tremendously since the Sinnoh League.
en: \rCynthia: Good to see you, \PN. I've seen you grow tremendously since the Sinnoh League.
it: \rCamilla: Che piacere vederti, \PN. Sei cresciuto tantissimo dai tempi della Lega di Sinnoh.

id: \rBut will that be enough to defeat me? Time to find out.
en: \rBut will that be enough to defeat me? Time to find out.
it: \rMa basterà per sconfiggermi? È ora di scoprirlo.

id: \rCynthia: If I was to lose to anyone here, it should be you. Don't hold back against Leon.
en: \rCynthia: If I was to lose to anyone here, it should be you. Don't hold back against Leon.
it: \rCamilla: Se dovevo perdere contro qualcuno qui, era giusto che fossi tu. Non risparmiarti contro Dandel.

id: \bLeon: At long last. It's Champion time!
en: \bLeon: At long last. It's Champion time!
it: \bDandel: Finalmente. È l'ora del Campione!

id: \bLeon: That was a great battle. I had fun! It reminded me of my first-ever Pokémon battle.
en: \bLeon: That was a great battle. I had fun! It reminded me of my first-ever Pokémon battle.
it: \bDandel: È stata una lotta fantastica. Mi sono divertito! Mi ha ricordato la mia primissima lotta Pokémon.

id: \bFrom today, I'm just another challenger. I'll have lots of battles and get even stronger! Let's battle again sometime.
en: \bFrom today, I'm just another challenger. I'll have lots of battles and get even stronger! Let's battle again sometime.
it: \bDa oggi sono solo uno sfidante come tanti. Farò un sacco di lotte e diventerò ancora più forte! Rifacciamolo prima o poi.

id: \bLance: We meet again under less dangerous circumstances, \PN.
en: \bLance: We meet again under less dangerous circumstances, \PN.
it: \bLance: Ci rincontriamo in circostanze meno pericolose, \PN.

id: \bLet me show you what a real Dragon Master's capable of.
en: \bLet me show you what a real Dragon Master's capable of.
it: \bLascia che ti mostri di cosa è capace un vero Maestro dei Draghi.

id: \bLance: We meet again under less dangerous circumstances, Monarch \PN.
en: \bLance: We meet again under less dangerous circumstances, Monarch \PN.
it: \bLance: Ci rincontriamo in circostanze meno pericolose, Monarca \PN.

id: \bLet me test my skills against you to see if I'm worthy of being the Monarch!
en: \bLet me test my skills against you to see if I'm worthy of being the Monarch!
it: \bLascia che metta alla prova le mie abilità contro di te, per vedere se sono degno di essere il Monarca!

id: \bLance: I'm impressed. You're deserving of the being the Monarch.
en: \bLance: I'm impressed. You're deserving of the being the Monarch.
it: \bLance: Sono colpito. Meriti di essere il Monarca.

id: \bLance: Not bad at all, \PN.
en: \bLance: Not bad at all, \PN.
it: \bLance: Niente male, \PN.

id: \bSteven: We battle again in the first round, \PN.
en: \bSteven: We battle again in the first round, \PN.
it: \bRocco: Ci affrontiamo di nuovo al primo turno, \PN.

id: \bSteven: We battle again in the first round, Monarch \PN.
en: \bSteven: We battle again in the first round, Monarch \PN.
it: \bRocco: Ci affrontiamo di nuovo al primo turno, Monarca \PN.

id: \bI've been waiting for the opportunity to go all out against you again. I won't lose!
en: \bI've been waiting for the opportunity to go all out against you again. I won't lose!
it: \bAspettavo l'occasione di dare di nuovo il massimo contro di te. Non perderò!

id: \bSteven: I couldn't have asked for a better battle. Good luck in the semi-finals, even if you won't need it.
en: \bSteven: I couldn't have asked for a better battle. Good luck in the semi-finals, even if you won't need it.
it: \bRocco: Non avrei potuto chiedere una lotta migliore. Buona fortuna in semifinale, anche se non ne avrai bisogno.

id: \bSteven: I couldn't have asked for a better battle.
en: \bSteven: I couldn't have asked for a better battle.
it: \bRocco: Non avrei potuto chiedere una lotta migliore.

id: \rIris: Hi \PN! Glad we get to battle each other, unlike our first time here. Just know that I'll be going all out, so you'd better do the same!
en: \rIris: Hi \PN! Glad we get to battle each other, unlike our first time here. Just know that I'll be going all out, so you'd better do the same!
it: \rIris: Ciao \PN! Sono contenta che possiamo lottare l'una contro l'altro, a differenza della prima volta qui. Sappi che darò il massimo, quindi faresti meglio a fare lo stesso!

id: \rIris: You're still so strong... I'll be cheering for you!
en: \rIris: You're still so strong... I'll be cheering for you!
it: \rIris: Sei ancora fortissimo... Farò il tifo per te!

id: \rIris: Yay! You'd better be rooting for me!
en: \rIris: Yay! You'd better be rooting for me!
it: \rIris: Evviva! Faresti meglio a fare il tifo per me!

id: \rCynthia: Good to see you, \PN.
en: \rCynthia: Good to see you, \PN.
it: \rCamilla: Che piacere vederti, \PN.

id: \rCynthia: Good to see you, Monarch \PN.
en: \rCynthia: Good to see you, Monarch \PN.
it: \rCamilla: Che piacere vederti, Monarca \PN.

id: \rI know how much you've improved from when we first met and that it's enough to defeat me even if I'm fully prepared.
en: \rI know how much you've improved from when we first met and that it's enough to defeat me even if I'm fully prepared.
it: \rSo quanto sei migliorato da quando ci siamo conosciuti e che basta per sconfiggermi anche se sono preparata al massimo.

id: \rThat's why I won't be holding back anything!
en: \rThat's why I won't be holding back anything!
it: \rPer questo non mi tratterrò affatto!

id: \rNot even my full power was enough... you're a truly impressive trainer, \PN.
en: \rNot even my full power was enough... you're a truly impressive trainer, \PN.
it: \rNemmeno tutta la mia forza è bastata... sei un Allenatore davvero straordinario, \PN.

id: \rThat really could've gone either way. I'm amazed how you could grow even more from our last battle, \PN.
en: \rThat really could've gone either way. I'm amazed how you could grow even more from our last battle, \PN.
it: \rAvrebbe potuto finire in entrambi i modi. Mi stupisce che tu sia riuscito a crescere ancora dalla nostra ultima lotta, \PN.

id: \bAlain: Even if you're not the Monarch anymore, I know that you're an opponent that's not to be underestimated.
en: \bAlain: Even if you're not the Monarch anymore, I know that you're an opponent that's not to be underestimated.
it: \bAlain: Anche se non sei più il Monarca, so che sei un avversario da non sottovalutare.

id: \bAlain: I didn't think I'd fight you as the current Monarch, \PN.
en: \bAlain: I didn't think I'd fight you as the current Monarch, \PN.
it: \bAlain: Non pensavo di affrontarti mentre sei il Monarca in carica, \PN.

id: \bNot much else to say. Give me an even more intense battle than the Kalos League finals!
en: \bNot much else to say. Give me an even more intense battle than the Kalos League finals!
it: \bNon c'è molto altro da dire. Dammi una lotta ancora più intensa della finale della Lega di Kalos!

id: \bAlain: As I'd expect from you. Stand proud \PN, you're strong.
en: \bAlain: As I'd expect from you. Stand proud \PN, you're strong.
it: \bAlain: Proprio come mi aspettavo da te. Sii fiero, \PN, sei forte.

id: \bAlain: Hah... that was a very narrow victory. Great battle, \PN. I'll be looking forward to our rematch.
en: \bAlain: Hah... that was a very narrow victory. Great battle, \PN. I'll be looking forward to our rematch.
it: \bAlain: Uff... è stata una vittoria di misura. Gran bella lotta, \PN. Non vedo l'ora della rivincita.

id: \rDiantha: Hey \PN. I've been looking forward to the day we would have an official full battle.
en: \rDiantha: Hey \PN. I've been looking forward to the day we would have an official full battle.
it: \rDiantha: Ciao \PN. Aspettavo il giorno in cui avremmo fatto una lotta completa ufficiale.

id: \rI know how strong you are, so don't hold anything back so I can do the same!
en: \rI know how strong you are, so don't hold anything back so I can do the same!
it: \rSo quanto sei forte, quindi non trattenerti, così potrò fare lo stesso!

id: \rDiantha: You're even stronger than when we last battled. Let's have another battle soon.
en: \rDiantha: You're even stronger than when we last battled. Let's have another battle soon.
it: \rDiantha: Sei ancora più forte dell'ultima volta che abbiamo lottato. Facciamo un'altra lotta presto.

id: \rDiantha: I couldn't have won without going all out. You're a truly strong trainer, \PN.
en: \rDiantha: I couldn't have won without going all out. You're a truly strong trainer, \PN.
it: \rDiantha: Non avrei potuto vincere senza dare il massimo. Sei un Allenatore davvero forte, \PN.

id: \bLeon: At long last, we're here again. It's Champion time!
en: \bLeon: At long last, we're here again. It's Champion time!
it: \bDandel: Finalmente, eccoci di nuovo qui. È l'ora del Campione!

id: \bLet's do this again some time.
en: \bLet's do this again some time.
it: \bRifacciamolo qualche volta.

id: \bLeon: Excellent battle. Let's do this again some time.
en: \bLeon: Excellent battle. Let's do this again some time.
it: \bDandel: Lotta eccellente. Rifacciamolo qualche volta.

id: \rMarnie: There you are. I'm glad you were able to make it. I'm sorry if my fans caused any problems.
en: \rMarnie: There you are. I'm glad you were able to make it. I'm sorry if my fans caused any problems.
it: \rMary: Eccoti. Sono contenta che tu sia riuscito a venire. Scusa se i miei fan ti hanno creato problemi.

id: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 15.
en: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 15.
it: Smart Rotom: In base ai risultati, la tua posizione in classifica ora è 15.

id: \rMarnie: You were amazing. And I did my best.
en: \rMarnie: You were amazing. And I did my best.
it: \rMary: Sei stato incredibile. E io ho dato il massimo.

id: \bSteven: I see we finally have the chance to battle each other. I've been waiting for the opportunity to go all out.
en: \bSteven: I see we finally have the chance to battle each other. I've been waiting for the opportunity to go all out.
it: \bRocco: Vedo che finalmente abbiamo l'occasione di affrontarci. Aspettavo l'opportunità di dare il massimo.

id: \bSteven: I couldn't have asked for a better battle. Good luck in the semi-finals.
en: \bSteven: I couldn't have asked for a better battle.  Good luck in the semi-finals.
it: \bRocco: Non potevo chiedere una lotta migliore. Buona fortuna in semifinale.
